results.title: Trump's job approval, immigration and assimilation, vaccines, and more: August 7 - 10, 2026 Economist/YouGov Poll

results.content:
A national Economist/YouGov poll released Aug. 4 found 41% of Americans said they would vote for a Democratic candidate for Congress if the election were held today, compared to 33% who said they would vote for a Republican candidate.

Yet the same poll found Trump's popularity is also wavering, with just 36% of Americans approving of his job performance as president and 60% disapproving.
results.title: Trump says the GOP base is 'angry at Republicans,' but not at him
